material.acceptance_criteria: A test imports ui_minimap.js and render3d.js and asserts: a press at the canvas centre centres the map (ui_minimap.js:175-184); zoomCamera keeps distance within minDistance and maxDistance (render3d.js:221-225); clampTarget keeps the target inside cam.bounds (render3d.js:201-205). The suite fails for every single-operator mutant of those functions.
material.description: Fact (dispatch 1792858790463-5851-c8dbc5fd57787e5d): the repo-wide search for minimap names only hud.js, play.js, play.html, docs and ui_minimap.js itself (ui_minimap.js:39-40, 203); no test file is among the matches. Dispatch 1792858698408-5749-fa5335eb04729e57: render3d is named by no test file. Unkilled surface: centreAt (js/client/ui_minimap.js:175-184), signature (ui_minimap.js:82), clampTarget (js/client/render3d.js:201-205), panCamera (render3d.js:210), zoomCamera (render3d.js:221-225).

notes.note: Triage refute (principle-only, no observable effect). The acceptance requires adding a test file, which the gm rule 'no test files, ever' (gm skill Section 3, predicate no-synthetic-test-files) forbids. The row names no player-visible symptom and no measurable defect at a path:line: a missing mutation kill is a coverage gap, not a finding under the finding rule. The code it names is present at the cited lines: ui_minimap.js:175-184 centreAt (read 175-195, dispatch 1792859780473-6588-eb18fc0a49d970ec), render3d.js:201-205 clampTarget, :210-218 panCamera, :221-225 zoomCamera (read 201-225, dispatch 1792859777868-6587-f676538b74eec446; session verify-MUTATION-trav-minimap-camera-1).

material.resolution: Stale: principle-only coverage gap with no observable effect; the acceptance (a new test file) is forbidden by the gm no-test-files rule.
material.subject: No test references the minimap or the camera zoom, pan or clamp, so no mutant of them can be killed
material.witness: render3d.js:201-225 read: clampTarget (201-205), panCamera (210-218), zoomCamera (221-225) present as cited; ui_minimap.js:175-195 centreAt present at 175-184 (dispatch 1792859780473-6588-eb18fc0a49d970ec). material.witness_plan: Apply each single-operator mutant of centreAt, clampTarget and zoomCamera to a scratch copy outside the repository and run the suite; every mutant fails at least one assertion.
